default_description_1.message: I develop web applications, with my primary research focused on getting you to the next page.

default_description_2.message: If you need help with one of my apps or need to contact me, please click the Help Button and I'll reply to you on GitHub as soon as I can.

default_description_3.message: If you're interested in trying one of my apps but need some reassurance that they're safe, please check out my privacy policy to see why you can trust me.

url_incrementer_description.message: URL Incrementer (URLI) lets you increment URLs and get to the next page in a variety of ways. URLI was first developed in 2010 and was published to the Chrome Web Store in 2011. My ongoing goal with URLI is to create the ultimate incrementer.

infy_scroll_description.message: Infy Scroll lets you add customized infinite scrolling to websites. Infy was first developed in 2015 and was published to the web stores in 2020 during the COVID-19 pandemic. Infy contains some innovative features like Multi Actions and support for AJAX/SPA sites.

downloadyze_description.message: Downloadyze is a simple downloader that lets you download multiple pages automatically. Downloadyze was originally part of URL Incrementer, but was fully reworked and released as a dedicated downloader in 2022 in order to offer the best possible multi page downloader.

elempick_description.message: ElemPick is a simple element picker that can generate CSS Selector and XPath expressions with a single click. ElemPick is included in many of my other apps and was released (standalone) in 2024.

url_increment_button_description.message: URL Increment Button is a 1-Click Button that can increment URLs. It can be used as a companion to URL Incrementer or standalone for users who do not need the complex features and settings that URLI offers.

url_decrement_button_description.message: URL Decrement Button is a 1-Click Button that can decrement URLs. It can be used as a companion to URL Incrementer or standalone for users who do not need the complex features and settings that URLI offers.

about_description.message: This site was designed using the same libraries that I use to design my apps, so you can preview what it's like to use them.

help_description.message: Need help with one of my apps? Please click the button below to visit my GitHub page and then click on the pinned repository for the app that you need help with. You can then go to the repository's "Issues" section and open an issue there and I'll reply to you as soon as I can.

support_description_x.message: Thank you so much for considering to support me and {{app_name}}. Your support would help me continue to develop and improve {{app_short_name}}. I can't accept donations, so I have prepared a Supporter (SP) Version of {{app_name}}.

support_description.message: Thank you so much for considering to support me. I'm currently setting things up, so please check back again soon!

support_sp_a.message: SP stands for "Supporter." It is not a Pro version. It has some extra decorative features, such as a supporter badge and theme, and a customizable dark mode. You will also get access to experimental features I do not feel comfortable making public. The only feature worth noting would be the AI feature (Chrome/Edge only), but it has no chance of being useful to you in its current state in V10.

support_donations_a.message: I would always feel like I have to give you something in return. I also know that there would be a few people who donate who would expect that I owe them something in the future. By making this a transaction, you are getting something in return for your financial support.

support_mor_1.message: If you would like to support me, please click the button below to visit my Merchant of Record, Polar, and purchase the SP Version of {{app_name}}. Remember: I do not handle or store your personal data, but Polar does. You may want to first read their

support_mor_3.message: to see if you can trust them (I do).

sp_feature_1.message: SP Badge and Theme — A special badge and theme to thank you for your support

sp_feature_2.message: Dark Mode — A darker and customizable dark theme (made for dark mode fans)

sp_feature_3.message: Auto Unlocked — Auto times and seconds restrictions unlocked

sp_feature_4.message: Experimental Features — Early access to previewing experimental or proof-of-concept features like AI (Chrome and Edge only)

d_feature_1.message: URL Crawling — Use the crawl URL action to crawl an entire website

d_feature_2.message: Multi Page Screenshots — Capture screenshots of multiple pages at once

d_feature_3.message: Multi Page PDFs — Generate PDFs of multiple pages at once

email_support.message: If you have any questions or need any help, please feel free to contact {{em}}.

thank_you_description_1.message: Thank you so much for choosing to support {{app_short_name}}! Only less than 0.1% decide to give, so that shows how truly kind and special you really are.

thank_you_description_2.message: Polar should be sending you an email with instructions on how to access the SP Version. (Remember not to share it; it's only for you!) If you didn't receive it or need any help, please contact me at {{em}} and I'll reply.

thank_you_description_3.message: Thank you again for your support and for being who you are! You *are* making a difference.

special_description.message: Thank you so much for your interest in Special. I'm currently setting things up, so please check back again soon!

privacy_policy_description_1.message: Your privacy and your trust in me are extremely important to me, which is why my apps do not collect any data from you.

privacy_policy_list_1.message: This software does not collect data from your device or computer.

privacy_policy_list_2.message: This software does not use analytic services.

privacy_policy_list_3.message: This software does not track you.

privacy_policy_list_4.message: This software will never be transferred to an entity who might change these terms in a malicious manner.

privacy_policy_list_5.message: Your data is stored locally on your device. For some apps, you have the option of contributing data or feedback via Google Forms, but this is purely optional and is always initiated manually by you and only when you want to.

privacy_policy_list_6.message: You have the option of supporting me through my Merchant of Record, Polar, by visiting their website. Any data you submit to them is governed by their Privacy Policy; I do not collect or store any of your data.
